name: sfcc-lucky-draw
description: SFCC/SFRA cartridges for US lucky draw campaigns: entries from paid orders and a free alternative method of entry, verifiable draws (committed seed, entry snapshot hash, result seal and recompute), winner verification, single-use coupon prizes and a Business Manager desk - with tests and illustrated docs. Legal approval required before production.
author: Vedesh Reddy

scripts.lint: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:isml && npm run lint:docs
scripts.validate: npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
